# Set Media Destination

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Sets the playback destination of the current media.

## Syntax

~~~~text
setMediaDestination(device: <#Variable#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
setMediaDestination(device: Homepod)
~~~~
